capabilities: switch between a Base's saved views from a tab strip
navigate view tabs with keyboard commands and wrapping
wrap or horizontally scroll tabs in narrow panes
pin views and assign per-view icons with Pro
remember and reopen each Base's last selected view
extras: Freemium: view switching, keyboard navigation and wrapping are free; pinned views and per-view icons require Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors). After updates the plugin opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer; embeds and inline base code blocks are not supported.
intentEvidence: Add and configure views through the native view menu, then use the strip for daily navigation.
problem: Obsidian's Bases exposes saved views only through a toolbar menu, so there is no always-visible way to see and switch between views of the same notes.

relations.evidence: Base View Switcher is a free alternative with custom buttons, icon or text mode, drag ordering and toolbar visibility options.
Base Views offers configurable view lists plus custom table and task list views.

summary: Tab strip under a Base's toolbar that lists its saved views for one-click switching, with keyboard navigation, wrapping and per-view pins.
